items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: That was one of them old Scott Joblin numbers though.

ctx.x: Who had the arrangement? Was it stock?

He had some arrangement and a lot of stock, but he had a lot of arrangements in there. I don't know who did the arrangement, but he had a lot of arrangements. He had a number like, they arranged called Boku Jack, McCarty Chop Suey, Nine In The Shed, all them kind of numbers. It was hard, hard stuff to play. Yeah, I had several more up in there. Sally Trombone had an arrangement on that. That was one of them old Scott Joblin numbers though. You know, but Louis had an arrangement, or somebody arranged it for him.…
